description: Read the messages of one conversation thread, incremental by `since`/`cursor`. Costs $0.0012 per read. Pass the `thread_id` from messages_list. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

since.description: Read only what changed after this value from a previous read.

name: message_thread
title: Read a Conversation Thread
